root: ^(You notice tears running down her face.) Have you found the person who’s done this yet? I just lost the love of my life! I have no idea what to do.

s: ^Where were you when the murder happened?
^Your dress seemed to be cut. Any story to that?

c-0: ^I was having dinner with the stage manager, he can verify himself. I was sitting in the VIP section during the whole of the play.
c-1: ^I went downstairs to find myself refreshments, and went backstage to give my husband words of support. When the lights went out, I went near the stage to see what happened, and when they came on, I saw the body. I thought the attacker was still there, so I ran. Part of my heel got lost too, near the right of the stage. Can’t see a thing in this darkness though…
c-2: ^I was rushing away from the monster who started this attack. I might have tripped or gotten my dress torn-up by one of those props. Also, I remember that other actor… what was his name… Mortimer? He seemed pretty cut up when I saw him right after.
c-3: ^Be safe, maybe the bastard who did this is still here...
